phrases.phrase: Authorized! You can close this tab - the terminal client will finish signing in on its own.
This login link has expired or was already used. Start again from your terminal.
The terminal client login is not configured. Ask the site administrator to create a public OAuth client and name it in Options → TuiLink.
Authorization was not granted. Back in your terminal, start the login again.
This kind of draft does not carry attachments.

The client ID of the public OAuth client the terminal client (wftui) signs in through: Setup → Service providers → OAuth clients. Its redirect URIs must include {boardUrl}/tui-done and http://127.0.0.1/callback. Leave empty to use the client titled "WindowsForum TUI".
Sign-in relay and draft sync for the wftui terminal client.
